records.text: A commenter using the name Chris proposed that the black-shirted figure might have feigned a limp to evade gait analysis, invoking alleged FBI use of that technique in the January 6 pipe-bomber investigation.
records.speaker: Chris (commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Easy hammer or I just read that Chris writes, perhaps the guy in the black shirt was walking with a limp to avoid gait analysis allegedly used by the FBI in the January 6th pipe bomber investigation.

verification.notes: The episode presents Chris's conditional hypothesis. Searches did not independently recover the original comment or case-specific proof of gait disguise. A comparison with another investigation is not proof of a trained operative or foreign intelligence involvement.
